evidence.note: The pooled counts are runs, not independent seeds: the fragility arms reuse the same 30 seeds at every magnitude and onset, and the M13 envelope reuses 4 seeds in every cell, so the run-level Clopper-Pearson bounds are optimistic; distinct_seed_bounds counts each seed once under the assumption (taken from the experiment specs) that arms share seeds. median_tests.assumption: b_s distribution reconstructed from per-level R1 counts assuming R1 is monotone in magnitude within each seed (test.json does not allow checking this); shifts move the whole distribution

assumptions.independence: H1a, H2 and H3 use disjoint seeds; the 0 s arms of the two bands and the posteriors of p0, q and pi2 are taken as independent; the two arms of a seed are independent given the rates
assumptions.labels: illustrative; the b_s distribution is reconstructed from 20 seeds; no rate is taken as exactly 1

rng_operations_disclosed.operation: SplitMix64 reference vector (seed 0, public) in a test; Monte Carlo cross-check of the H3 median interval with a generator seeded 20261123 (a sampling seed)
start-state and stream-position arithmetic for seeds 44000-44919 (and 44000-44999), sources 1 to 12; sorted gaps; no output words

explicit generation of output words for the streams (44000, source 2) and (44128, source 6): 8 and 4 words in one interactive check, the first 6 and 2 printed to the console; the test generated the same 6 and 2 words on every run
position arithmetic of the 44000-44919 streams against the seen and protected ranges, against the extended list and inside the seen ranges; no output words
test generating explicit output words for the pairs (44000, 1) and (42016, 3) (3 and 1 words) and (44804, 10) and (41212, 12) (7 and 5 words) on every run; asserted equal, not printed or stored
position arithmetic only for 81000-81999, 80920-80999 and the candidate blocks scanned from 60000; no output word of those seeds; tests generate words only on the synthetic block 90000-91999

s4_s5.success_definition: S4: guarded without rule 2 meets R1 AND robust fails R1 on the same seed; S5: registered guarded meets R1 AND the 1000 m threshold arm fails R1 on the same seed. Both are conjunctions over two arms, like H1.

s4_s5_mcnemar.rule: exact one-sided sign test on the discordant pairs at 0.01/7, at least 10 discordant pairs; pairs with R1 not evaluated in either arm count as discordant in the contrary direction

seed_independence.method: start-state and position arithmetic only (seed ^ source*G, increment G, used draw counts); no output word of any stream is generated
not_established: seeds derived in code from other numbers (offsets, hashes, loops) that appear in no text line with the word
seeds in untracked files (for example runs/), in other branches or worktrees, in pull-request text or in notes
seeds at or above 2^24 that are not integers on a seed line
seed_independence.same_seed_pairing: the two or more arms of one seed use the identical streams (same positions): intentional pairing inside an experiment; the checks above compare different seeds, and different sources of one seed, so they exclude it
